title: Text: DET Nick Castellanos ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Got an e-mail tonight that you have a Zoom call tomorrow. My two cents: I’d be classy AF to the Tigers and not get into it that much. They’re all going to be going for the revenge angle but your mindset bigger than that, this is just the first three games
That’s the angle I’d be going for but I’m not gonna ask questions, I bet it’s gonna be a circus if it’s both Tigers and Reds media
